_about: A viewing policy learned on top of the frozen, released CanViT-B and its frozen ADE20K linear probe (64 x 64 canvas), from the authors' unpublished reinforcement-learning experiments (read 2026-10-23): mean and standard deviation across 8 training seeds of ADE20K validation mIoU (%), the paper's protocol. Every rollout starts with the full-scene glimpse (t = 0), as EG-C2F's does, so t = 0 is the paper's 39.6. Training: 640k glimpse-forwards, about 80 minutes per seed on one RTX 4090; the reward is how much a glimpse reduces the segmentation error; the policy chooses each next glimpse among 512 candidate viewpoints. Baselines on the slide come from the paper's export (assets/paper/ade20k_seg.json), not from this file.
